terra.problem: It guesses why John included the name. Papa Dorin cannot add a reason the text does not give, even as a guess.
Matthew 26:36 alone does not establish that Jesus prayed there before His arrest. The reference needs to include the subsequent verses.
John 5 does not say the man could not walk.
Calling Son of David a good title for Jesus draws on a fact outside the passage without a reference.
John does not say people could walk right up to the sign.
The connection between the temple and Jerusalem is outside this passage and needs a reference.
The text does not say Pilate had a pen or whether he picked it up.
John says the soldiers cast lots, but does not say one of them walked away with the tunic.
The quotation in John and Psalm 22:18 do not use the exact same words.
It claims to know that the baker will remember the answer.
It identifies Jesus' mother as Mary without a reference establishing that identification.
John says the jar was sitting there, but does not say it stayed in place.
Calling it a quiet moment adds a detail about the scene that the text does not give.
